 Pistons vs. Nets Discussion: Game Time, TV, Odds, and More
 NBA Cup play begins as Detroit faces Brooklyn
 by Sean Corp Oct 30, 2026, 11:31 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The Detroit Pistons have run quite a gauntlet to start the season, playing Giannis Antetokounmpo and the Miami Heat, the title-seeking Boston Celtics and Philadelphia 76ers, the defending champion New York Knicks, and the frisky Charlotte Hornets. Today, they play one of the only two winless teams in the NBA in the Brooklyn Nets. I’m not saying the Pistons can’t lose — every team in the NBA is capable of beating every other team in the NBA on any given night. But hopefully, tonight is the kind of game where the Pistons find plenty of time for rookie Ebuka Okorie, and it is because there is plenty of garbage time in the fourth quarter, and that garbage time is because the Pistons are way ahead. It’s also technically the start of NBA Cup play, which, I guess, matters to some people for some reason.
 Game Vitals
 When: 7:30 p.m. ET
 Where: Barclays Center, Brooklyn, New York
 Watch: TV: TV20 Detroit | Streaming: DAZN-Det
 Odds: Pistons -7.5
 Projected Lineups
 Detroit Pistons (4-1) 
 Cade Cunningham, Duncan Robinson, Ausar Thompson, John Collins, Jalen Duren
 Brooklyn Nets (0-4) 
 Mikel Brown Jr, Nolan Traore, Michael Porter Jr, Julius Randle, Day’Ron Sharpe
